content.text:
I'll add cosign keyless signing to both the goreleaser config and the release workflow.

**What this does:**
- Signs the checksum file with cosign using OIDC-based keyless signing (Sigstore/Fulcio)
- The workflow gets `id-token: write` permission for the OIDC token
- Cosign is installed in the workflow before goreleaser runs

Since the checksums file covers all archives, signing just the checksums file is sufficient to verify the integrity of everything.

input.new_string:
checksum:
  name_template: "checksums.txt"

signs:
  - cmd: cosign
    certificate: "${artifact}.pem"
    args:
      - sign-blob
      - "--output-certificate=${certificate}"
      - "--output-signature=${signature}"
      - "${artifact}"
      - "--yes" # keyless signing (Sigstore/Fulcio OIDC)
    artifacts: checksum

Both files look correct. Here's a summary of the changes:

**`.goreleaser.yaml`** — Added `signs` section (lines 64-73):
- Uses `cosign sign-blob` with keyless signing (`--yes`)
- Signs the `checksum` artifact (checksums.txt), which transitively covers all archives
- Outputs both the signature (`.sig`) and certificate (`.pem`) files that get uploaded to the release

**`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — Two changes:
- Added `id-token: write` permission (line 11) — required for the GitHub OIDC token that Fulcio uses to issue the ephemeral signing certificate
- Added `sigstore/cosign-installer@v4` step (line 21) — installs cosign before goreleaser runs

**Release artifacts will now include:**
- `checksums.txt` (existing)
- `checksums.txt.sig` (cosign signature)
- `checksums.txt.pem` (Fulcio certificate)

Users can verify with: `cosign verify-blob --certificate checksums.txt.pem --signature checksums.txt.sig --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com --certificate-identity-regexp 'github.com/entireio/cli' checksums.txt`

### Download & Verify (manual install)

Pre-built binaries are available from the [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases) page. All release checksums are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/) using keyless (ephemeral) signing via Sigstore, so you can verify that artifacts haven't been tampered with.

```bash
# 1. Set the version and platform
VERSION="0.1.0"              # replace with desired version
OS="linux"                   # linux or darwin
ARCH="amd64"                 # amd64 or arm64

# 2. Download the archive, checksums, signature and certificate
BASE_URL="https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases/download/v${VERSION}"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/entire_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt.sig"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt.pem"

# 3. Verify the signature on the checksums file
cosign verify-blob checksums.txt \
  --certificate checksums.txt.pem \
  --signature checksums.txt.sig \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'github\.com/entireio/cli'

# 4. Verify the archive against the signed checksums
sha256sum --check --ignore-missing checksums.txt

# 5. Extract and install
tar xzf "entire_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
sudo install -m 755 entire /usr/local/bin/entire
```

> **Note:** On macOS, use `shasum -a 256 --check --ignore-missing checksums.txt` instead of `sha256sum`.

```bash
# Install via Homebrew

# Or install via Go
go install github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire@latest

cd your-project && entire enable

# Check status
entire status
```

### Download & Verify (manual install)

Pre-built binaries are available from the [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases) page. All release checksums are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/) using keyless (ephemeral) signing via Sigstore, so you can verify that artifacts haven't been tampered with.

```bash
# 1. Set the version and platform
VERSION="0.5.0"              # replace with desired version
OS="linux"                   # linux or darwin
ARCH="amd64"                 # amd64 or arm64

# 2. Download the archive, checksums, signature and certificate
BASE_URL="https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases/download/v${VERSION}"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/entire_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt.sig"
curl -fsSLO "${BASE_URL}/checksums.txt.pem"

# 3. Verify the signature on the checksums file
cosign verify-blob checksums.txt \
  --certificate checksums.txt.pem \
  --signature checksums.txt.sig \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'github\.com/entireio/cli'

# 4. Verify the archive against the signed checksums
sha256sum --check --ignore-missing checksums.txt

# 5. Extract and install
tar xzf "entire_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
sudo install -m 755 entire /usr/local/bin/entire
```

> **Note:** On macOS, use `shasum -a 256 --check --ignore-missing checksums.txt` instead of `sha256sum`.
